content.text:
.controls .instui-tooltip z-index is 30 and .canvas-rce-shell__panel z-index is 60, but when the panel is visible (menu open) the buttons still display "over" the menu. it visually looks like the layer order top to bottom is:
.canvas-rce-shell__option
.controls .instui-tooltip
.canvas-rce-shell__panel

but the hover order is:

.controls .instui-tooltip
.canvas-rce-shell__option
.canvas-rce-shell__panel

the actual order (both over and non-hover) should be:

.canvas-rce-shell__option
.canvas-rce-shell__panel
.controls .instui-tooltip

content.text:
The problem was a stacking context. `.canvas-rce-shell` has `backdrop-filter`, which makes it its own stacking context, so the panel's `z-index: 60` only counts inside the shell. The shell's own `z-index: 10` was being ignored because it had no `position` set. That left the whole shell, panel included, below the `.controls` tooltips at 30/40.

The fix is in [app.css](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/app.css#L64-L69): I gave the shell `position: relative` and raised its `z-index` to 50. That's above the tooltips (30/40) and below the fullscreen preview (100), so the order is now option → panel → tooltip for both hover and non-hover.

I regenerated the scaffold snapshot, but I haven't checked the change in the browser yet.
